description: This file defines the MutableMediaMetadata class, which encapsulates MediaMetadata and provides mutable access to modify metadata without rebuilding collections. It also overrides equals and hashCode based on trackId.

classes.name: MutableMediaMetadata
classes.description: A holder class that wraps MediaMetadata and allows for mutable modifications of media metadata, identified uniquely by trackId.

methods.name: MutableMediaMetadata
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the metadata and trackId.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare trackId fields for equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce hash based on trackId.
